text: Hello, welcome to the help desk. What can I do for you today? Hi, I am looking for a book on ocean pollution, but I cannot find it on the shelf. Let me check the catalog. It seems our copy is checked out, but I can reserve it for you. Yes, please reserve it. How long does it usually take to come back? Usually about a week. In the meantime, we have an electronic version you can read online for free. That would be great. Could you show me how to access the electronic version? Sign in to the library website with your student account and search the title. I will use my student account to find the online book. The online version is available now. We will also email you when the printed copy returns. Thank you. I can start reading online while I wait for the printed copy.
